description: Replace one exact substring in a document (str_replace semantics) without resending the whole file. THE PREFERRED WAY TO MAKE SMALL EDITS to large docs like STATE.md. old_str must match EXACTLY ONCE - zero or multiple matches are rejected rather than guessed. Pass new_str as an empty string to delete. Same versioning, archiving, and sha256 read-back as write_doc.

edits.description: Several replacements in one revision. Each old_str must match the current text exactly once. Applied together, so a failed edit writes nothing.

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

new_str.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the matched text.

old_str.description: Exact text to replace. Must occur exactly once in the current text. Omit when `edits` is set.

origin.description: Required when a board edit adds a row id. Names the session, chat or drop the row came from.

reason.description: Required, at least 10 characters. A removed or closed board row says why.

session_id.description: Transcript session id. The floor is measured from the size when this session first touched the document.

source.description: Source tag - which host produced this write. One name on every write since 2026-09-27.

updated_by.description: Alias of `source` (the older name, kept one release). Prefer `source`.

name: patch_doc
